figures.caption: Figure 6: Facing new-arrival tasks with ➊, ➋ determines adaptation tasks to service based on task demands and system states while updating ➊ through online profiling. During task execution, for each layer, ➌ identifies tokens for computation and feeds it back to ➍ which schedules the execution of experts to maximize their computation parallelism. Meanwhile, ➌ reuses other tokens with low I/O overhead to improve I/O efficiency.
